## About
Network Alignment & Brakes is a family owned and operated shop that has served the valley for years. We specialize in alignment, suspension and brakes for all cars and trucks, from daily drivers and work trucks to weekend autocross cars.
Our goal is simple: honest, quality work at affordable prices. If your car doesn't need anything, we'll tell you. That's a big part of why customers have given us a 4.5 rating from 987 Google reviews.
You'll find us on Bethany Home Road in Glendale, with a second shop on Cave Creek Road in Phoenix. Appointments are made by phone, so give us a call.

## Services
- Front wheel alignment and toe set: Adjusts your suspension components to the proper angles. Ask us about the warning signs to watch for.
- Thrust alignment: Aligns the front wheels to the rear axle, so the car tracks in the direction the rear wheels are pushing.
- Four wheel alignment with mechanical rear wheel adjustment: Typically needed on all-wheel-drive models with independent suspensions.
- Brake parts and service: A complete offering of brake parts and service for your car. Call us to talk through what you need.

## FAQ
Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call. Appointments are made by phone only. You can email questions, but booking happens over the phone.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes. We're open every day of the week, including Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on trucks?
A: Yes. We handle alignment, suspension and brakes for all cars and trucks.
